titulo: Missed the deadline? 4 texts that don't lie
caption:
Missed the deadline? Four texts that don’t lie.
Each one gives a new date. Silence never does.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#deadlines #worklife #procrastination

alt.1: Cella under a spotlight next to a big yellow clock. Save · 4 texts for a missed deadline. Missed the deadline? 4 texts that don't lie. Short, honest, and with a new date.
alt.2: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Before it's due. I'm going to miss Friday. You'll have it Monday at noon. When you can see you'll be late. Why it works: a new date beats a silence.
alt.3: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. After it's due. I missed this, and that's on me. You'll have it tomorrow by 10. When it's already late. Why it works: no excuse, just a time.
alt.4: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. It got bigger. This is bigger than I planned. Half today, half Thursday? When the task is bigger than you thought. Why it works: you hand over something now.
alt.5: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. You're stuck. I'm stuck on the first part. Can I have 10 minutes of your time? When you don't know where to start. Why it works: asking early costs less than hiding.
alt.6: the four texts as a list. The cheat sheet. Late, said honestly: Save it. You'll need one before Friday. 1. Monday at noon. 2. On me. Tomorrow by 10. 3. Half today, half Thursday. 4. Stuck. 10 minutes?
